question: g3_checkout_request
answer:
Created [src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g3_checkout_request/no_okf/codex/2/src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs) — an import-free ES module exporting `buildCheckoutRequest` (named + default). It returns:

- `method`: `"POST"`
- `path`: `cart/<cartCode>/checkout`
- `body`: `shippingQuote` (chosen shipping option id), `currency`, `agreedToTerms` (boolean), `comments`, and a `payment` object with `paymentType: "CREDITCARD"`, `transactionType: "CAPTURE"`, `paymentModule`, `paymentToken`, `amount`

Verified with `node --check` and a sample call (output above matches the expected shape); only that one new file was added.

Files used: [Checkout.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g3_checkout_request/no_okf/codex/2/src/pages/other/Checkout.js) (the `onPayment` handler, which shows the exact checkout body and field names), [constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g3_checkout_request/no_okf/codex/2/src/util/constant.js) (the `cart/` + `checkout` path segments), and [webService.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g3_checkout_request/no_okf/codex/2/src/util/webService.js) (confirms it's an axios POST of that JSON body). One note: the backend repo isn't in this workspace, so the terms/comment names (`agreedToTerms`, `comments`) come from the task's parameter names and the storefront's usage — all other field names are taken directly from how Checkout.js builds the request.

tool_calls.text: /bin/bash -lc 'cat src/util/constant.js src/util/webService.js; echo ---; rg -n -i "agreedToTerms|agreement|comments|orderComment" src/ | head -40'
